entries.name: -allow360
entries.description: Allows 360-pixel-wide video modes to remain in the mode list, which the client otherwise drops to save space when many 320-wide modes exist.

entries.name: -basedir
entries.description:
The "base" directory is the path to the directory holding the quake.exe and all game directories.

This can be overridden with the "-basedir" command line parm to allow code debugging in a different directory.

entries.name: -bpp
entries.description: Allows setting of 'r_colorbits' cvar during start-up

entries.name: -cddev
entries.description: On Linux, specifies the cd device to use.  Must specify -cdaudio for this to have effect. (is this only used in meson build?)

entries.name: -cdmediacheck
entries.description: Enables periodic checking for CD media changes (a disc being inserted or removed) for CD audio playback.

entries.name: -condebug
entries.description: log all console output to qw/qconsole.log

entries.name: -conheight
entries.description: set vid_conheight during startup

entries.name: -conwidth
entries.description: set vid_conwidth during startup

entries.name: -current
entries.description: Uses the current desktop resolution as the fullscreen video mode instead of switching to a preset mode.

entries.name: -d
entries.description: (SVGAlib build) Sets the color depth, in bits, of the requested video mode, used together with -w and -h.

entries.name: -dibonly
entries.description: Forces the WinQuake software renderer to use only the GDI/DIB output path, disabling DirectDraw and WinDirect.

entries.name: -dinput
entries.description: Uses DirectInput for mouse input instead of standard Windows messages, giving more reliable raw movement.

entries.name: -force
entries.description: Adds a custom video mode (from -width/-height) to the mode list even if the display did not enumerate it.

entries.name: -fullsbar
entries.description: Draws the status bar across the full width of the screen rather than at console width.

entries.name: -gamma
entries.description: Sets the initial gamma value at startup (`-gamma <float>`, range 0.3-3.0), overriding the `gl_gamma` cvar default before the first frame.

entries.name: -gl11
entries.description: Forces the plain OpenGL 1.1 path (loading opengl32.dll), bypassing multitexture and other extensions.

entries.name: -h
entries.description: (SVGAlib build) Sets the height, in pixels, of the requested video mode.

entries.name: -heapsize
entries.description: Sets the hunk memory allocation to `<kilobytes>` (`-heapsize <kb>`, e.g. `-heapsize 65536` for 64 MB). Legacy KB-denominated form; if both `-heapsize` and `-mem` are present, `-mem` wins.

entries.name: -height
entries.description: Sets the vertical resolution in pixels (`-height <pixels>`). Applies to `vid_height` (fullscreen) or `vid_win_height` (windowed, when `-window` is present). Should be paired with `-width`.

entries.name: -ip
entries.description: Binds all network sockets to the specified local IP address rather than all interfaces (`-ip <address>`). Affects both UDP and TCP listen sockets (client and server). Default is `INADDR_ANY`.

entries.name: -lm_1
entries.description: Selects the GL_LUMINANCE single-channel OpenGL lightmap texture format (the default).

entries.name: -lm_2
entries.description: Selects the GL_RGBA4 (16-bit) OpenGL lightmap texture format.

entries.name: -lm_4
entries.description: Selects the full GL_RGBA (32-bit) OpenGL lightmap texture format.

entries.name: -lm_a
entries.description: Selects the GL_ALPHA single-channel OpenGL lightmap texture format.

entries.name: -lm_i
entries.description: Selects the GL_INTENSITY single-channel OpenGL lightmap texture format.

entries.name: -mdev
entries.description: (Linux build) Sets the mouse device file to read, overriding the default /dev/mouse.

entries.name: -mem
entries.description: Sets the hunk memory allocation to `<megabytes>` (`-mem <mb>`, e.g. `-mem 64`). Canonical form; overrides `-heapsize` when both are specified.

entries.name: -minmemory
entries.description: Sets the hunk allocation to the engine minimum (~5.3 MB); takes no argument. Superseded by any subsequent `-heapsize` or `-mem` on the same command line. Use when testing under minimal memory conditions.

entries.name: -mode
entries.description: Selects the fullscreen video mode by its number in the mode list.

entries.name: -mrate
entries.description: (Linux build) Sets the serial mouse sample rate, overriding the default of 1200.

entries.name: -no8bit
entries.description: Disables the 8-bit shared-texture-palette OpenGL extension, forcing full-color textures.

entries.name: -noadjustaspect
entries.description: Stops the client from halving the width of very wide (dual-monitor) video modes.

entries.name: -noautostretch
entries.description: Prevents the client from automatically choosing a stretched windowed mode on desktops wider than 640 pixels.

entries.name: -nocdaudio
entries.description: Disables CD audio (music) playback entirely.

entries.name: -noconinput
entries.description: Disables reading console commands from stdin. POSIX/Linux only.

entries.name: -nodd
entries.description: Disables DirectDraw, forcing the WinQuake software renderer onto the GDI path (alias of -nodirectdraw).

entries.name: -noddraw
entries.description: Disables DirectDraw, forcing the WinQuake software renderer onto the GDI path (alias of -nodirectdraw).

entries.name: -nodirectdraw
entries.description: Disables DirectDraw, forcing the WinQuake software renderer onto the GDI path.

entries.name: -noforcemaccel
entries.description: Stops the client from overriding the Windows mouse acceleration setting while running.

entries.name: -noforcemparms
entries.description: Stops the client from overriding the Windows mouse parameters (threshold and speed) while running.

entries.name: -noforcemspd
entries.description: Stops the client from overriding the Windows mouse speed setting while running.

entries.name: -noforcevga
entries.description: Stops the software renderer from forcibly including the 320x200 VGA mode in the mode list.

entries.name: -nofulldib
entries.description: Disables the use of a fullscreen DIB (GDI) video mode in WinQuake.

entries.name: -nojoy
entries.description: Disables joystick input.

entries.name: -nokbd
entries.description: (Linux build) Disables keyboard input handling.

entries.name: -nomouse
entries.description: Disables mouse input.

entries.name: -nomtex
entries.description: Disables OpenGL multitexturing in the Classic renderer (prevents loading of `glMultiTexCoord2f`, `glActiveTexture`, and `glClientActiveTexture`), and additionally disables fog rendering engine-wide. Use when multitexturing causes corruption on old or non-standard GL drivers.

entries.name: -nosound
entries.description: Skips SDL audio initialization entirely, leaving all sound subsystems inactive for the session. Distinct from the `s_nosound` cvar, which allows initialization but suppresses playback at runtime.

entries.name: -nostdout
entries.description: Suppresses stdout output on POSIX by setting `sys_nostdout=1` before `Host_Init`. POSIX/Linux only.

entries.name: -notriplebuf
entries.description: Disables triple buffering of the video output.

entries.name: -novesa
entries.description: Disables the WinDirect fullscreen video path in the WinQuake software renderer (treated like -nowindirect).

entries.name: -nowd
entries.description: Disables the WinDirect fullscreen video path (short form of -nowindirect).

entries.name: -nowindirect
entries.description: Disables the WinDirect (MGL) fullscreen video path in the WinQuake software renderer.

entries.name: -particles
entries.description: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously active particles to `<count>` (`-particles <count>`), overriding the `r_particles_count` cvar at startup. Default is 2048; the active particle subsystem clamps to its own range (classic: 512-8192, QMB: 256-32768).

entries.name: -primarysound
entries.description: Mixes directly into the DirectSound primary buffer instead of a secondary buffer, reducing latency on some hardware.

entries.name: -resetwinpos
entries.description: Resets the saved game-window position to the default, useful if the window opened off-screen.

entries.name: -simsound
entries.description: Enables fake-DMA sound: the mixer runs but no audio is sent to the hardware (used for testing).

entries.name: -sndbits
entries.description: (Linux/OSS build) Sets the sound sample size in bits (8 or 16).

entries.name: -sndmono
entries.description: (Linux/OSS build) Forces single-channel (mono) sound output.

entries.name: -sndspeed
entries.description: (Linux/OSS build) Sets the sound sample rate, in Hz.

entries.name: -sndstereo
entries.description: (Linux/OSS build) Forces two-channel (stereo) sound output.

entries.name: -snoforceformat
entries.description: Stops the DirectSound code from forcing its preferred sample format on the output device.

entries.name: -startwindowed
entries.description: Starts ezQuake in windowed (non-fullscreen) mode. Similar to `-window` but does not affect how `-width`, `-height`, or `-display` are routed to cvars.

entries.name: -surfcachesize
entries.description: Sets the size, in bytes, of the surface cache used by the software renderer.

entries.name: -verbose
entries.description: (X11 build) Prints extra diagnostic information about the display and chosen visual at startup.

entries.name: -visualid
entries.description: (X11 build) Selects a specific X11 visual by its numeric id instead of letting the client choose.

entries.name: -w
entries.description: (SVGAlib build) Sets the width, in pixels, of the requested video mode.

entries.name: -wavonly
entries.description: Uses the older waveOut sound output instead of DirectSound.

entries.name: -width
entries.description: Sets the horizontal resolution in pixels (`-width <pixels>`). Applies to `vid_width` (fullscreen) or `vid_win_width` (windowed, when `-window` is present). Should be paired with `-height`.

entries.name: -window
entries.description: Starts ezQuake in windowed mode and routes `-width`, `-height`, and `-display` to the windowed resolution cvars (`vid_win_*`) instead of the fullscreen ones. Distinct from `-startwindowed`, which sets windowed mode without affecting cvar routing.

entries.name: -winsize
entries.description: (X11 build) Sets the client window size as width and height in pixels.

entries.name: -zone
entries.description: Sets the size, in bytes, of the zone memory heap used for small dynamic allocations.
